subject: general
question: Sri Lanka got independence in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is **__1948__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka**

 
 
• **As the Dominion of Ceylon,** Ceylon gained independence on February 4, 1948. For the following 24 years, **Sri Lanka maintained its dominion status within the British Commonwealth**.
 
• On May 22, 1972, it was renamed the Republic of Sri Lanka and became a republic.
 
• **In 1815, the island was united under British control **following the Kandyan Wars.
 
• Both the **1848 Matale Rebellion and the 1818 Uva Rebellion involved armed** uprisings against the British. Although the nation attained independence in 1948, it remained a Dominion of the **British Empire until 1972.**
 
• **Off the southern coast of India** sits the little island country of **Sri Lanka. **
 
• **In 1948**, it became independent of** British authority.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The years between** 1815 and 1948 are known as the British Ceylon period in Sri Lankan histor**y.
 
• It happens after the British Empire conquers the **Kandyan Kingdom.**
 
• It put an end to the island's more than 2300 years of** Sinhalese monarchy rule.**
 
• The** island nation of Sri Lanka,** historically known as Ceylon, is located in the Indian Ocean and is divided from** peninsular India by the Palk Strait.**
 
• The **Indian Subcontinent never included Sri Lanka.**
 
• Sri Lanka has kept its distinct culture and customs alive for the **past three thousand years. **
